decisions.rationale: Auralis is Next-native; a 4-act WebGL scroll film does not survive hand-translation to vanilla HTML.

reskinPlan.note: Auralis ground is fog, not a swatch. Retint must move fog, backdrop bottom and --scene-backdrop together or a seam appears at the horizon.
reskinPlan.accentSwap: Auralis violet #b552ff (emitted light only) -> ShopyLink #0EA5E9 / glow #38BDF8
reskinPlan.typeSwap: Google Sans Flex -> Bricolage Grotesque (display) + Manrope (body) + Tajawal (Arabic)

blocked.reason: Egress proxy returns 403 CONNECT for mcp.getlayers.ai and storage.getlayers.ai
blocked.consequence: 7 binary assets unreachable; text source still reachable via getlayers_source over MCP
blocked.fix: Allowlist both hosts in the environment network policy, then build.downloadProject fetches the whole project in one request.
